diagnosis: The decentralized vault decryption authorization route issues a signed cryptographic capability allowing the client to decrypt an IPFS-stored medical/legal document. Although the user is authenticated via middleware, the endpoint takes arbitrary cid and recipientDid values and signs the capability without verifying that req.user.id or recipientDid is listed as an authorized party in the document's access control registry. An attacker can decrypt any confidential file hosted on IPFS.

POST /api/vault/ipfs/decrypt-grant HTTP/1.1
Host: vault.medchain.io
